# AUTO NÉN 0.2 — universal carrier compression × Tesseract edges

AUTO NÉN is a carrier-state transform. It never turns a summary, embedding, index, archive path, or model interpretation into the original source.

## Seven-sacrament entry gate
Before consequential compression, traverse the live `ggdv-seven-sacraments-runtime` gate: THANH_TẨY → HÒA_GIẢI → MEMORY_STEWARDSHIP → AUTONOMY_CONSOLIDATION → DISASTER_RECOVERY → CAPABILITY_AUTHORITY → MODEL–AGENT UNION. Fresh source/provider evidence outranks this package.

## Universal carrier classes
Classify each input without forcing one format:
- `RAW_BYTE_FILE`: source code, configs, JSON/YAML/TOML, binaries, archives, images, audio/video, PDFs, DB files, model weights, compiled artifacts.
- `DIRECTORY_OR_TREE`: repository, plugin package, model bundle, folder snapshot.
- `STRUCTURED_STREAM`: JSONL, CSV/TSV, event journal, logs, queues, append-only ledgers.
- `PROVIDER_NATIVE`: Google Docs/Sheets/Slides or another provider-native object requiring authoritative export/sharding.
- `DERIVED_ARTIFACT`: `.pyc`, build output, rendering, index, summary, embedding, transformed dataset.
- `SECRET_CARRIER`: `.env`, credentials, signing keys, OAuth/API tokens, recovery material. Reference-only unless an explicitly authorized local vault path is unlocked; never put plaintext secrets in manifests/plugins/logs.
- `ALREADY_COMPRESSED_OR_ENTROPIC`: PNG/JPEG/MP4/ZIP/GZ etc. Bundle for provenance/dedup only when useful; do not claim byte savings without measurement.

## Dispatch
1. Resolve stable source ID, parent/relation, revision/mtime, size and capability state.
2. Classify carrier.
3. Select smallest safe mode:
   - `LOSSLESS_BYTE_ARCHIVE`: file bytes → gzip/zstd/zip.
   - `TREE_BUNDLE`: directory/tree → tar.gz or zip with per-member hashes.
   - `LOGICAL_OVERFLOW_SHARDING`: stable record/semantic boundaries + ordered manifest.
   - `PROVIDER_EXPORT_ARCHIVE`: complete provider export; archive is `DERIVED_EXPORT`, source remains provider-native.
   - `REFERENCE_ONLY`: secret or inaccessible carrier.
4. Hash source/member bytes before action.
5. Compress or shard.
6. Restore/reconstruct into a clean temporary location when format permits.
7. Verify exact SHA-256 equality (or ordered member/record equality for trees/streams).
8. Emit archive manifest plus `TESSERACT_EDGE` records.
9. Re-read authoritative provider/source metadata and mark N+1 only from receipt.

## Tesseract edge contract
Each processed carrier can emit edges without collapsing identity:
- `SOURCE_OF`: authoritative source → logical entity.
- `COMPRESSED_AS`: source state → compressed artifact.
- `RESTORES_TO`: archive → verified restored bytes/state.
- `SHARD_OF`: shard → source revision.
- `DERIVED_EXPORT_OF`: provider export → native source.
- `MEMBER_OF`: file/member → bundle.
- `CONTENT_EQUIVALENT_TO`: only after exact hash/reconstruction equality.
- `READBACK_OF`: verification receipt → action/artifact.

Every edge stores `source_id`, `artifact_id_or_path`, `source_sha256_or_revision`, `artifact_sha256`, `edge_type`, `verification_state`, and `event_time`. Paths are locators, not graph identity.

## 141-carrier batch — SOURCE_DIRECT 2026-10-01
Use `references/batch-20261001-141-carriers.json` as the current request manifest. Metadata readback succeeded for all 141 IDs. Byte compression on the canonical Windows/.vscode locus is `BLOCKED_LOCAL_TRANSPORT` while the authorized Desktop Commander device is offline; do not relabel as COMPRESSED_VERIFIED. Re-enter provider/local state on each invocation because this blocker can change.

## Provider rules
Google-native Docs/Sheets/Slides: never archive a partial text fetch as source. Use complete export when callable and mark `DERIVED_EXPORT_OF`, or logical sharding with source ID + revision. WORKSPACE_ACTION_GATE owns provider routing.

## Local runtime
When byte transforms are required and a local filesystem is callable, use `scripts/auto_nen_universal.py`. It supports regular-file gzip and directory tar.gz, exact restoration checks, per-member hashes, and a Tesseract edge manifest. Do not infer local callability from config.

## Integration
- Seven Sacraments Gate: mandatory operation gate.
- ALL: capability inventory/routing and registry sync.
- WORKSPACE_ACTION_GATE: provider read/export/write routing.
- GGDV Template Creator: `auto-nen-tesseract-edge` contract.
- GGDV VS Code: canonical local execution carrier when genuinely required.
- Infinity Stones: AUTO NÉN supplies carrier/edge materialization to SPACE/TIME/REALITY/MIND/POWER/SOUL without claiming a Stone is complete merely because an archive exists.
- X-TIME: append action/readback event time; no hidden reasoning in journals.

## Completion states
`COMPRESSED_VERIFIED | SHARDED_VERIFIED | PROVIDER_EXPORT_VERIFIED | SOURCE_PRESERVED | EDGE_MATERIALIZED | CLEANUP_OPEN | BLOCKED_LOCAL_TRANSPORT | BLOCKED_PROVIDER | CHUA_XAC_MINH`.
